edits.label: MainZone-Other
edits.why: line 28 is the centred title of text 139 (Kalђé-këdân. Одѣтый въ цѣльно сшитое платье.), directly under the number heading; a heading is MainZone-Other, not a continuation.

notes.text: Indented colophon (Записано отъ чукчи Чόцо ...) is band 3, MainZone-P; indented so P stands, but an editor may prefer Other.
Line order 11 13 12 and 35 34 in the bands is the text layer's row order; the ink is ordinary consecutive lines.
